from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,math
sys.path.insert(0,'C:/Users/dfred/AppData/Local/Temp/s169af-arb')
from flint import arb,ctx
ctx.prec=512
sat=Path('C:/Users/dfred/Desktop/Projects/IGH/quantyra-wormhole-semiclassical')
def p(n):return json.loads((sat/'evidence'/(n+'.json')).read_bytes())['runs'][-1]['result']
def dec(v):
 d=v['decimal_enclosure'];return arb(int(d['mid']),int(d['rad']))*arb(10)**int(d['exponent'])
tr=p('current-reference-clock-adjoint-trial');pa=p('current-global-mass-conversion')['parameters']
C=1/dec(pa['u']);etaG=C/dec(tr['B_squared_over_G'])
ga=dec(p('current-coupled-global-return-attempt')['gamma'])
pi=arb.pi();a=arb('.05');b=arb('.1');binp=arb('.2');d=arb(5).sqrt()*(binp-b)
cM=arb(2).sqrt()*d;cp=arb(10).sqrt()*d
Aj=[]
for j in range(5):
 v=arb(2560)*etaG/pi*math.factorial(j)*1000**j*(1+ga*cp)*sum((math.comb(j,k)*math.factorial(j-k+3)*math.factorial(k)/(cM**(j-k+3)*cp**(k+1)) for k in range(j+1)),arb(0))
 Aj.append(v)
hh=[arb(1)]+[arb(math.factorial(21)//math.factorial(21-l))*2**(l-1)/arb(2).log()**l for l in range(1,5)]
def cc(alpha):
 rows=[[arb(1)]]
 for m in range(3):
  old=rows[-1];rows.append([(alpha+j)*(old[j] if j<len(old) else 0)+(old[j-1] if j else 0) for j in range(m+2)])
 return rows
rows1=cc(arb('.995'));rows0=cc(arb('-.005'))
L=[];L0=[];L1=[]
for k in range(4):
 one=arb(0);zero=arb(0)
 for l in range(k+1):
  for j in range(k-l+1):
   one+=math.comb(k,l)*hh[l]*abs(rows1[k-l][j])*b**(arb('.995')+j)*Aj[j+1]/(2*(arb('.995')+j)).sqrt()
   power=arb('-.005')+j
   maxpow=a**power if j==0 else b**power
   zero+=math.comb(k,l)*hh[l+1]*abs(rows0[k-l][j])*maxpow*Aj[j]*arb(2).log().sqrt()
 L0.append(zero);L1.append(one);L.append(one+zero)
nf=lambda v:sum((math.comb(3,k)*v[k]*v[k] for k in range(4)),arb(0)).sqrt()
out={'exploratory':True,'Aj':[str(v) for v in Aj],'cutoff_guards':[str(v) for v in hh],
 'direct_gradient_coefficient':str(900*nf(L1)),'original_row_transition_coefficient':str(900*nf(L0)),
 'complete_actual_far_graph_per_energy':str(900*nf(L)),
 'actual_linear_far_graph_upper':str(900*nf(L)*arb('1.1e-10'))}
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
Path(__file__).with_suffix('.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
